### How to reach the venue

The nearest international airport is 50 km away in [Porto](https://www.portoairport.pt/en/opo/home). To reach Braga, we recommend taking one of the many direct buses from Porto airport to the Braga central bus station (for example, [GetBus](https://www.getbus.eu/en/), but check Google Maps for more options).

To reach the Gualtar Campus from the Braga central bus station, you can take a taxi or use public transportation. The university is well-connected by local buses, and you can check Google Maps for the most convenient route and schedule.

### About Braga

Braga is one of the oldest Portuguese cities, as well as one of the oldest Christian cities in the world. It was founded in Roman times, under the name of Bracara Augusta and, today, it boasts 2000 years of history as a city. Located in the north of Portugal, in the Cávado Valley, Braga has roughly 174 thousand inhabitants. 

Braga also offers unique cultural and leisure opportunities in the country, with its nightlife, cinemas, theatres, exhibitions, museums and art galleries. It is a city full of culture and traditions, where history and religion coexist side by side with the technology industry and academic life.

For touristic information about Braga, please visit the [official website](https://www.visitbraga.travel/en/).
